Per-tier calibration status of a demand contract (with fallback)

Source: R/dpmm_contract.R
dpmm_tier_status.Rd

Returns the provenance of a single `tier`, preferring the per-tier `tier_calibration_status` (via [read_dpmm_demand_contract()]'s `tier_status`) and falling back to the object-level `status` when the contract predates the per-tier column. Pure; no I/O.

Usage

dpmm_tier_status(ct, tier = DPMM_DEFAULT_TIER)

Arguments

ct

list from [read_dpmm_demand_contract()] (or `NULL`).

tier

denominator tier to look up. Default `"tier3_prevalent_pfd"`.

Value

character scalar (the tier's status), or `NA_character_`.
